review_scope: Compare each frozen output only with its immediate model input. Do not revise candidates or infer fidelity from detector results.

review_item_template.notes: Any correction is a finding for a future process revision, not permission to change this tested output.

completion_requirements: Verify the source and candidate hashes against exact UTF-8 text.
Review every entity, number, study method, outcome and stated relationship.
Distinguish missing detail, changed qualifications and changed logical scope from harmless rephrasing.
Document tone and readability observations separately from information retention.
Report every output, including failures; do not select candidates using detector scores.
